answer: Sybil resistance rests on a slashable stake: each agent locks collateral as an anchor of its identity, and a verifier maps one deposit to one key. Any key caught signing two identities forfeits the whole deposit. Influence is proportional to locked stake, so N fake votes require N independent bonds, and one detected double-sign burns them all. The zephyr client checks deposit proofs before counting votes; the falcon audit randomly re-verifies a sample each epoch. The attacker's cost scales with forged identities and is lost on detection, far above the gain from flipping one marginal vote.
